player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Slitherlink wɔ {R}x{C} grid so!
Wɔn na ɔkwan baako a ɔntwa kɔn mu sɛdeɛ kɔkɔro biara wɔ hɔ a, ɛwɔ sɛ ɛhɔfoɔ no sua kɔn no.
Sesa kɔn no sɛdeɛ:
  [h r c] - sesa kɔn a ɛwɔ dots no akyi wɔ safu r, gyinabea c
  [v r c] - sesa kɔn a ɛwɔ dots no nifa wɔ safu r, gyinabea c
Nsɛm no kyerɛ sɛ kɔn no dodoɔ, '.' kyerɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ den.
Wo wɔ {max_turns} sɛ wobɛtumi atoɔ puzzle no.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɔkasa a action no saa. Fa [h row col] anaa [v row col].

outcome.win: Woayɛ ade koro a ɛbɔ ho ban! Wɔadi nsɛnnennen no so nkonim!
outcome.turn_limit: Akwantu ho hye no adu. Asɛntitiriw a enni awiei.
